marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 從負債2000萬到心想事成每一天 : 15個實現願望的口頭禪,符合宇宙法則,越說越好運! | Cong fu zhai 2000 wan dao xin xiang shi cheng mei yi tian : 15 ge shi xian yuan wang de kou tou chan, fu he yu zhou fa ze, yue shuo yue hao yun!

This book tells the story of a middle-aged "loser" nearly crushed by his dreams, who managed to turn his life around after being 20 million NT dollars in debt. At his lowest point, with nowhere left to turn, he cried out in the bathroom, pleading with the universe for help. In that moment, a mysterious figure—“Mr. Universe”—emerged from the showerhead and offered to help him rise from rock bottom. The only catch? He had to agree to every condition Mr. Universe set.What followed was a series of grueling “boot camp” lessons—from confronting his inner self and acknowledging his current reality, to discovering the incredible workings of the universe, learning how to make wishes the right way, and using powerful mantras to rewrite his life. As he began to experience one miracle after another, everything changed. By the end of the story, readers will have a powerful realization: “Mr. Universe” was actually the author's own awakened sixth sense—his deep connection with the universe itself
